_meta.label: Custom-prepared from manual research
_meta.caveat: Written from general knowledge of who publishes Kenyan statistics. No URL below was requested when this file was prepared: page URLs are the publishers' landing or listing pages and must be confirmed by a gated probe before any loader relies on them. Every licence is recorded as unassessed until checked against the publisher's terms. Sites are created with status expected.

publishers.name: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
publishers.role: The national statistical office: census, economic survey, household surveys.

publishers.name: Kenya Open Data Portal
publishers.role: Government open data catalogue (CKAN-style dataset listings).

publishers.name: Communications Authority of Kenya
publishers.role: Telecommunications, internet, mobile and broadcasting statistics (quarterly sector statistics reports).

publishers.name: Commission on Revenue Allocation
publishers.role: County revenue sharing, fiscal data and marginalisation index.

publishers.name: Central Bank of Kenya
publishers.role: Monetary, exchange rate, banking and public debt statistics.

publishers.name: UN OCHA Humanitarian Data Exchange
publishers.role: COD-PS population statistics and COD-AB boundaries by administrative unit; CKAN API.

publishers.name: The DHS Program (ICF)
publishers.role: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey tables; registration is needed for microdata, the StatCompiler/API gives indicators.

publishers.name: WorldPop (University of Southampton)
publishers.role: Gridded population estimates and constrained country totals.

publishers.name: The World Bank
publishers.role: National population series and development indicators (already loaded for the national total).
